v0_14_0.title: What's new in 0.14.0
items: A warning now appears when two active variables are redundant or conflict with each other (for example WineD3D with DXVK-based options, or DLSS4 Upgrade with the NGX Updater)
Variables with a list of predefined values, and the version/home-page pickers in Settings, now use a new custom dropdown.
Deselecting every value of a multi-choice variable now turns it off instead of leaving it active with an empty value
Variables can now be organized into sub-categories, and a variable can reveal a nested sub-group of related options once it's turned on
Long commands or file paths in the command list now wrap onto multiple lines instead of running off the screen.

v0_13_1.title: What's new in 0.13.1
items: Installing a version picked from the list in Settings now reliably reloads the plugin

v0_13_0.title: What's new in 0.13.0
items: New 'Active' section at the top of the game page and the Global Commands page, showing everything currently enabled without having to scroll through every category — can be turned off in Settings
Deleting a custom variable or wrapper now also turns it off everywhere it was active, instead of leaving it stuck on with no way to disable it
The launch log now only shows commands that are actually active for each launch, so a global command disabled for a specific game no longer shows up as if it were still on

v0_12_0.title: What's new in 0.12.0
items: Notification when a plugin update is available
One-click install from Settings — any past release can be installed too, not just the latest
Option to hide the Variable list page from Settings if it's not used
Custom commands and wrappers can now be edited instead of having to delete and recreate them
The plugin now reloads itself automatically after updating or reinstalling — no more manually reloading it from Decky's settings

v0_11_2.title: What's new in 0.11.2
items: Custom commands and favorites can now be deleted
Added buttons in Settings to clean up custom wrappers or custom commands, each with a confirmation step
Uninstalling now cleans up generated files (script, wrapper cache) while keeping all your data, so reinstalling starts fresh
You can now browse past What's New updates — from the home banner or a new history section in Settings

v0_11_1.title: What's new in 0.11.1
items: Fixed a bug where updating could lose your custom variables, favorites, or settings — legacy data is now recovered automatically
Custom variables now show up in the Global Commands page too

v0_11_0.title: What's new in 0.11.0
items: New Global Commands page: enable commands for every game with the wrapper at once, right from the top bar
Disable a globally-enabled command for just one game, from that game's own page
Wrappers (lsfg, fgmod...) now work the same way, and you can add your own custom wrapper
Favorites now show full controls (enable/disable, enum values) instead of a plain toggle
Favorites, settings and custom items are now stored more reliably
The wrapper script no longer clutters your home folder
